reply: Thank you for explaining that a medical debt is being reported and collected using information you did not consent to share. We understand your privacy concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask in writing for details of the debt and its source, and review your credit report for how medical debt is shown. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two charged-off accounts bought by a collector show balances higher than you owed the original creditor, and that your dispute was not answered. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written dispute for each account, asking for an itemized balance, and keep your earlier payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your dispute of a $350.00 collection notice and your concern about how the account was reported. We understand why you want this reviewed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your dispute, and ask in writing for the account details and the disclosures you received when it was opened. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received several calls from the collector in two days and have voicemails to show it. We understand how disruptive this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the voicemails and a call log, and send a written request about how and when you want to be contacted. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that late payments and a charge-off were reported after you paid off and closed your loan, and that the account was then sold to a collector. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep proof of your payoff, and send a written dispute to the collector and the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your follow-up about the debt validation response you received. We understand you do not accept it. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep copies of your letters and the response, and ask in writing for the original creditor, the amount owed and how that amount was calculated. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent $800.00 after depositing checks that were later returned as bad, and that your requests to get the money back were declined. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the check details and messages, and be wary of anyone who sends you a check and asks you to send money back. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concern that your disputes about payment app transfers were not investigated and that you were told the money could not be recovered. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please list each transfer with its date, amount and recipient, and ask in writing for the result of each investigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concern about how your payment app disputes were handled and that you were told tracking the transfers was not possible. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written list of each transfer you disputed, with dates and amounts, and ask for the result of each claim. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing that your payment app disputes were not investigated in the way you expected and that the funds were described as unrecoverable. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep records of each transfer and your reports, and ask in writing for a written decision on each dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have verified your identity several times but still cannot move the funds from your old account. We understand your frustration after months. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep confirmations of each verification, and ask in writing for the balance to be sent to you by card or check. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have reset your password but still cannot see your account, and that you have been asked to withdraw your funds without explanation. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the emails you received, and ask in writing for the reason for the request. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your membership was upgraded without your permission to a higher monthly charge, and that your request to cancel went unanswered. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep your cancellation email, and send another written request to cancel and to stop any further charges. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent money to an investment platform that froze your account, and that you now believe it was a scam. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the transfer records and messages, and be wary of anyone offering to recover lost funds for a fee. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent bitcoin to a trading site that later demanded a withdrawal fee, and that you now believe it was a scam. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the transaction records and site details, and be wary of offers to recover the funds for a fee. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a large escrow shortage appeared soon after your loan moved to a new servicer, and that you have not received a clear explanation. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written request for the escrow history from both servicers and the latest escrow analysis. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a certified request for information about the past due amount on your loan, and that you have not received a response. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please keep the certified mail receipt and a copy of your request, and follow up in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told you must pay about $33,000.00 before loss mitigation options would be reviewed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the loss mitigation team. Please send a complete loss mitigation application in writing and keep proof of delivery. Servicers generally must review complete applications. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your HELOC applications were declined or delayed because of data entry errors and income that was not counted. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the home equity team. Please ask in writing for the specific reasons for each decision and a full list of the documents still needed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $2,400.00 in property taxes was paid from your escrow to the wrong parcel, and that you have not received a refund. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error with your parcel details and the treasurer's records, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your mortgage payment rose by $300.00 without notice. We understand how difficult this is to plan for. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written request for the escrow analysis or other notice that explains the change, and ask about spreading any shortage over time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your servicer did not take part in a state mortgage relief program and that you then received a foreclosure letter. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the loss mitigation team. Please respond to any deadlines on the letter, and ask in writing about available options to avoid foreclosure. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you switched home insurance companies and were told the refund from your old policy would be handled, but you later received an unexpected letter. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send your new policy details in writing and ask for an escrow history showing any refund. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a lapse in flood insurance paid through your escrow was not caught before your loan transferred, and that it has cost you money. We understand your concern on a fixed income. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please ask both servicers in writing for the escrow and insurance payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you accepted a $2,000.00 line of credit and gave your bank details, and then received an email saying you were declined. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the specific reason for the decision, and confirm that no payment authorization remains active. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you lost your job and tried to revoke payment authorization for your advances, but the company refused. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the payments team. Please keep the chat record, and tell your bank in writing that you have revoked the authorization. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you took out a loan at 160% APR during a stressful time and believe it does not follow your state's rate rules. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep your loan agreement and payment records. Your state's financial regulator can explain the rules that apply where you live. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received an unrequested loan check with a 91.25% APR. We understand your concern about what could have happened if it were stolen. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please do not cash the check unless you want the loan, and you can opt out of these offers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you did not realize refinancing your personal loan online would pay off your existing loan, and that you could not cancel it. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the screens or emails from the online process, and ask in writing for the disclosures you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the solar system financed by your loan has not lowered your electricity bills as you were told it would, and that the terms were not clear to you. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the contract, sales materials and utility bills, and ask in writing for a copy of all loan disclosures. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
